sb_prompt: FIND OUT FROM THE OTHER CALLER WHAT KIND OF CAMPING THEY HAVE DONE.  HOW DOES IT COMPARE WITH YOUR OWN EXPERIENCES?
turns: Yeah, I'm a carpenter so I spend a lot of time outdoors, usually just pitching a tent in the backwoods while fixing something, but it's actually pretty wild when you think about it compared to just checking into a hotel room.
Yeah, I'm more of a resort camper, mostly just tents at the state park near my house, but honestly, that whole backwoods thing kind of scares me.

Yeah, I'd tell you exactly what to do if you wanted to try it, my buddy Dave went out in the deep woods last month and slept in his van under some old pines, but he told me he was scared stiff the first night too until he just realized nobody was coming to bother him.
Yeah, but after that first night, I guess it was just quiet? I've been thinking about that for years, honestly, but I never really got past the scary part.
Yeah, it's just the dark getting into your head until you remember you're in control of everything.
Yeah, quiet is a good thing, I guess, but it's just so different from being inside with the lights on.
Yeah, you'd never get that silence inside unless you just turned off the AC and let the wind blow through the cracks.
Yeah, but I still feel like I'd have to pack up if something rattled at 3 AM.
Yeah, but once you get used to it, that rattle just sounds like a squirrel or the wind, not something bothering you.
Yeah, but I guess if it's just the wind, maybe I could try it once with you guys.
Yeah, I'm in this weekend; just pitch up and watch the sunrise.
Yeah, but that sunrise sounds kinda far out for a bank teller.
Yeah, look, I've got a friend who's a cop and he's actually out there tonight too, so we'll just watch you set up and we won't say much so you can get used to the quiet.
Yeah, but you guys camping alone sounds kinda scary to me, I wouldn't feel safe with just strangers there.
Yeah, but it's just my buddy Dave and me, plus that cop, so we keep watch and you can come if you really want, no strangers at all.
Yeah, but even with a cop there, sleeping in a tent just feels so different than my little cabin at the park.
Yeah, but it's way safer than that cabin, the wood stays warm and the tent keeps bugs off you.
Yeah, but a cabin feels safe because it's got walls and a lock, I just can't shake that feeling.
Yeah, you can lock the tent flap if you really want to, it's just different from being inside.
Yeah, but I still can't imagine myself just letting myself get that close to the edge without feeling like something's gonna jump out at me.
Yeah, you're thinking of a house, but a tent is just a big leather blanket and if you build it right there's nothing to jump at you.
Yeah, but you can't really build a tent with walls and a lock, that's just not how it works.
Yeah, but you can reinforce the seams so tight that nothing gets past the fabric, not even a fox.
Yeah, but if a fox is outside, my cabin door stays locked and I don't have to worry about my bag.
Yeah, but you can bring your lock with you and tape it to the zipper so you don't even have to worry about it opening.
Yeah, but I just can't see myself carrying that stuff around with me all night.
Yeah, you can just put a heavy rock on the zipper so it stays shut, it's easy enough.
Yeah, but I still can't shake the feeling that if I leave the zipper open, something's gonna come in.
Yeah, just tape the zipper shut and put a rock on it, you won't have to leave your bag inside.
Yeah, but that rock sounds heavy and I don't want to lug that around all night.
Yeah, just tie a knot around it and call it good, you won't feel the weight, I promise.
Yeah, but I still can't imagine lugging rocks all night just to keep bugs out.
Yeah, just tape the zipper, it's light as a feather, I promise you won't feel the weight.
Yeah, but tape still sounds like a bandage and I'm not sleeping with my whole body wrapped up.
Yeah, just use a clip that comes with the tent, nobody lugs rocks around anymore.
Yeah, but clips still feel flimsy and I'd rather just go back to my cabin tonight.
Yeah, just pitch it up at the state park where I usually am, nowhere near the deep woods, we can keep it close to the road so you don't feel trapped.
Yeah, but I don't think I can get used to the backroads at all, even if you make it close to the exit.
Yeah, but we can drive your car right up to the spot and I'll just hold the tent flap open for you while you step in so you don't have to carry any rocks or tape.
Yeah, but I can't carry your tent to the car and I'm not driving.
